description: This file implements a factory for creating F1C network clients and includes classes for handling SCTP and F1AP message conversions between the DU and the F1-C gateway, including network connection management.

classes.name: sctp_to_f1c_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts packed F1AP PDUs from the F1-C GW into unpacked PDUs and forwards them to the DU.

classes.name: f1c_to_sctp_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts unpacked F1AP PDUs from the DU into packed PDUs and forwards them to the F1C-GW.

classes.name: f1c_sctp_gateway_client
classes.description: Manages SCTP network connection and message handling between the DU and the F1-C gateway.

methods.name: handle_du_connection_request
methods.description: Establishes SCTP connection and returns a notifier for message forwarding.
